# uasset-allowlist.txt - the ONLY binary assets allowed under port/unreal.
# Checked by port/check-uassets.ps1 (run it before every commit).
# Entries: paths relative to port/unreal, forward slashes, PowerShell -like
# patterns. Every entry must name WHY it exists and HOW it regenerates.

# Vendored RealtimeMeshComponent plugin (third-party, MIT - see CREDITS.md).
# Its Content/ ships example Blueprints/materials we never edit.
Plugins/RealtimeMeshComponent/*

# P3 near-empty world map - regenerated by port/unreal/Tools/make_p3_map.py
# (UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=pythonscript). Holds no logic; C++ spawns everything.
Content/Maps/P3World.umap

# Procedural first-pass materials - regenerated by
# port/unreal/Tools/gen_assets.py (UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=pythonscript).
# Parameter-driven so BUILDER-ASSETS can swap real textures in later.
Content/Materials/M_Terrain.uasset
Content/Materials/M_Road.uasset
Content/Materials/M_Ocean.uasset
Content/Materials/M_Placeholder.uasset

# Burst-FX materials (BUILDER-BRIDGE, P3/P4) - regenerated by
# port/unreal/Tools/gen_fx_assets.py. Consumed by Source/.../bridge/fx/.
Content/FX/M_FxFlash.uasset
Content/FX/M_FxFlare.uasset
Content/FX/M_FxDirt.uasset
Content/FX/M_FxSmoke.uasset

# Radio-net sounds (BUILDER-BRIDGE, P4) - reimported by
# port/unreal/Tools/gen_audio_assets.py from Tools/audio_src/*.wav
# (CC0 recording + gen_audio_src.py synthesis; port/CREDITS.md).
Content/Audio/S_BoomDistant.uasset
Content/Audio/S_SquelchClick.uasset
Content/Audio/S_NetHiss.uasset

# BUILDER-ASSETS (P3) imported art content - regenerated end-to-end by
# port/unreal/Tools/download_assets.py (pinned URLs + licenses in
# Tools/asset_manifest.json, provenance in port/CREDITS.md) followed by
# Tools/import_assets.py (UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=pythonscript).
Content/Textures/*
Content/Vegetation/*
Content/Models/*

# NOTE: Content/Materials/M_Terrain.uasset and M_Road.uasset (allowlisted
# above) are now regenerated by Tools/import_assets.py (texture-sampling
# graphs, same parameter names); gen_assets.py's procedural versions remain
# the no-content fallback. Run order: gen_assets.py, then import_assets.py.
